description: This file contains the implementation of a Lexer class for parsing PDF files, including tokenization, string handling, number parsing, and stream reading functionalities, primarily used during PDF file processing within the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: A lexical analyzer class designed for parsing and tokenizing PDF streams, handling various token types such as names, numbers, strings, arrays, dictionaries, comments, hex strings, and stream data within PDF files.

methods.name: ScanNextToken
methods.description: Reads the next token from the PDF stream and determines its symbol type, including handling comments, names, numbers, keywords, strings, arrays, dictionaries, and EOF.

methods.name: ScanComment
methods.description: Skips over a comment line in the PDF stream.

methods.name: ScanName
methods.description: Parses a PDF name object beginning with '/' and handles UTF-8 decoding if necessary.

methods.name: ScanNumber
methods.description: Reads a number token, recognizing integers, longs, real numbers, and object references with lookahead for 'R'.

methods.name: ScanKeyword
methods.description: Reads a keyword and identifies known PDF keywords like 'obj', 'endobj', 'null', 'true', 'false', 'stream', 'endstream', etc.

methods.name: ScanStringLiteral
methods.description: Parses a string literal enclosed in parentheses, handling escape sequences, octal characters, and nested parentheses.

methods.name: ScanHexadecimalString
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal encoded string enclosed between '<' and '>'.

methods.name: TryScanLiterally
methods.description: Attempts to match a specific literal string at the current stream position; restores position if matching fails.

methods.name: FindStreamStartPosition
methods.description: Locates the starting position of a stream after the 'stream' keyword and ensures proper handling of line endings.

methods.name: ScanStream
methods.description: Reads a specified length of bytes from the stream at a given position, handling partial reads and EOF conditions.

methods.name: DetermineStreamLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of a stream based on the 'endstream' marker, handling ill-formatted PDFs.

methods.name: TryScanEndStreamSymbol
methods.description: Checks for the 'endstream' marker after reading stream data.

methods.name: ScanRawString
methods.description: Reads raw string data from the stream at a specified position.

methods.name: MoveToNonWhiteSpace
methods.description: Advances stream position to the next non-whitespace character.

methods.name: DumpNeighborhoodOfPosition
methods.description: Returns a string representing characters around a given position, useful for debugging.

methods.name: ScanNextChar
methods.description: Advances to the next character in the stream, with optional handling of CRLF sequences.
